attempt01.result: Native/facade and six callback controls passed. Retained fixture gate failed on an inference-allocated output refreshed outside InferenceMode. Synthesized gate was not launched; launcher failed fast.

followups.history_diagnostics: Exact posthoc diagnostic script/report retained separately; descriptive mechanisms and three observed slower explicit winners, not a new cohort or causal proof.
followups.native_acceptance_design: Source-only design for guarding actual future selected-descriptor consumption outside timing; not implemented or established by the setup smokes.
followups.next_study: A proposed fixed objective-by-activation-values mechanism comparison is retained as a proposal, with individual timing deferred and rare-event/power limits explicit. No implementation or launch.

limits: No serving-throughput, model-performance or small selection-improvement claim; setup smoke timings are deliberately not interpreted.
Retained versus synthesized mode changes profile domain/cache keys and is not an activation-values-only contrast.
No graph-policy persistence/restart, production dependency change, managed-store migration, distributed GPU/EP/MegaMoE/BF16 or full-model qualification.
Public raw includes exact originals and clearly identified derived records. Exhaustive module manifests, private tensors, ELF/build cache and whole upstream source remain private.

provider_identity.note: Build locations and the delay-helper ELF differ across attempts and are retained explicitly. Each attempt's fresh workers are checked against its own exact provider bytes; do not claim universal binary identity across attempts.
provider_identity.source_difference_between_attempts: Benchmark callback inference context only; exact native/runtime source hashes match.

resources.final_gpu: No workload GPU processes and zero used memory; only the pre-existing monitor container remains.
resources.queue: The settled snapshot has empty squeue output. The earlier CG snapshot is preserved separately and is not used as empty-queue evidence.

revision02.change: Only the already-owned output NaN fill enters inference_mode; every ownership guard and callback position remains unchanged. Standalone callback controls now cover both normal and inference tensor allocation.
revision02.native_control: One explicit functionality descriptor is accepted at M144 and M129, with true memory hits and genuine default misses. Fifteen numerical guards and two retained graphs pass; zero profiling attempts.
revision02.result: All four gates pass in four fresh containers: native-facade, twelve callback correctness controls plus four unsafe-role checks, retained-auto and synthesized-auto.
revision02.scope: Two short validation rounds per smoke establish API/cache/numerics only. They are not independent performance trials and do not establish selected-descriptor acceptance for a future comparison.

source_variant: FP8-only descriptor port plus optional benchmark fixture output-refresh callback; not stock released FlashInfer.
status: Current-source correctness/provider and fixture API setup qualified on revision02; revision01 failure preserved.
